categories.main_business_segments: Hunan Goke Microelectronics Co., Ltd. primarily operates in integrated circuit design focusing on ultra-high-definition intelligent display, smart vision, automotive electronics, edge AI, Internet of Things (IoT), and solid-state storage chip products and related IC design services. The company develops and sells chips for satellite and cable set-top boxes, IPTV/OTT boxes, TVs, network cameras, NVR/DVR devices, solid-state drives, automotive positioning and navigation, and wireless LAN chips.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs fabless manufacturing, outsourcing wafer production, packaging, and testing to specialized foundries. Core technologies include video codec, image and audio signal processing, SoC chip design, live satellite channel demodulation, GNSS positioning, mixed-signal integration, advanced security encryption, solid-state storage controller chips, multi-wafer packaging, embedded software development, AI NPU design, and wireless RF technology. It also develops AI chips based on an innovative MLPU architecture optimized for large model inference with high energy efficiency.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are enterprises in the electronic information industry, including cable and satellite TV operators, telecom operators (China Telecom, China Mobile, China Unicom), security and surveillance companies, automotive manufacturers and Tier 1 suppliers, IoT device manufacturers, and data storage product makers. The company serves markets such as broadcasting, IPTV/OTT, smart security, automotive electronics, AI edge computing, and wireless connectivity.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company primarily operates in mainland China, with over 88% of revenue generated domestically. It also has a presence in overseas markets accounting for approximately 11.6% of revenue. Subsidiaries and investments are located in major Chinese cities including Changsha, Shanghai, Beijing, Hangzhou, Shenzhen, and others.
categories.supply_chain_position: Hunan Goke Microelectronics operates at the upstream design stage of the semiconductor supply chain as a fabless IC design company. It focuses on chip design and development while outsourcing wafer fabrication, packaging, and testing to foundries and subcontractors.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes continuous R&D investment in ultra-high-definition display chips (4K/8K), smart vision chips with AI capabilities, automotive AI and SerDes chips, wireless LAN chips (Wi-Fi4, Wi-Fi6, and Wi-Fi7 pre-research), and solid-state storage controllers. It pursues AI edge computing with a focus on large model AI SoCs based on its MLPU architecture. The company also prioritizes integration with the domestic HarmonyOS ecosystem and aims to expand AI applications in smart terminals, robotics, and industrial computing.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of integrated circuit products and related design services. The company sells chips directly and through distributors, providing turnkey solutions for vertical markets. It also earns income from licensing and government subsidies related to technology development.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: In ultra-high-definition display chips, competitors include Amlogic, MediaTek, Rockchip, and Allwinner. In smart vision, competitors include Fuhan Micro, Beijing Junzheng, StarFive, Realtek, and Huawei HiSilicon. Automotive AI chip competitors include Ambarella, Horizon Robotics, and Texas Instruments. In wireless LAN chips, competitors include Realtek, MediaTek, Aikewi, and Southern Silicon Valley. The company is positioned as a leading domestic IC design firm with strong competitiveness in several niche segments and is recognized for its AI SoC innovation.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 1.98 billion, a 53.26% decrease from 2023, with a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 97.15 million, slightly up by 1.13%. The company’s total assets were about RMB 7.67 billion, with equity of RMB 4.10 billion. Despite revenue decline, R&D investment increased by over 10% to RMB 675 million, representing 34.14% of revenue, indicating a focus on long-term growth and innovation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its strong自主研发 (independent R&D) capabilities, offering high integration, low latency, low power consumption, and cost-effective chip solutions with full domestic intellectual property rights. Its AI SoC products uniquely support large model inference efficiently, differentiating from traditional NPUs. The company’s products support domestic standards (AVS2/AVS3, HDR VIVID, Audio VIVID) and HarmonyOS ecosystem compatibility, providing comprehensive end-to-end solutions across multiple application domains including broadcasting, security, automotive, AI edge computing, and IoT.
